metadata.title: Bazaar — handmade goods from Vietnamese makers
metadata.description: Shop ceramics, silk, fashion and more from independent makers across Vietnam.

home.heading: Handmade goods from independent Vietnamese makers
home.lead: Ceramics from Bát Tràng, silk from Hà Đông, and more — straight from the people who make them.

pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.lead: Simple fees for sellers. Shopping on Bazaar is free.

plans.title: Free to list
plans.text: Add as many products as you like at no cost.

plans.title: 8% per sale
plans.text: A commission only when you sell, including payment fees.

plans.title: Weekly payouts
plans.text: Your earnings are paid every week, in USD.

about.title: About us
about.lead: Bazaar connects independent Vietnamese makers with shoppers who care where things come from.

story.title: Craft deserves a market
story.text: Generations of skill should reach buyers far beyond the village.

story.title: Transparency
story.text: Clear prices, clear shops, clear delivery — in two languages.

story.title: Small is fine
story.text: One person with a kiln can run a shop as well as a big brand.

sell.title: Become a seller
sell.lead: Open a shop in minutes and reach shoppers in Vietnam and abroad.

steps.title: Create an account
steps.text: Sign up and verify your email.

steps.title: Apply to sell
steps.text: Tell us your shop name; we review applications quickly.

steps.title: List your products
steps.text: Add photos, prices and stock from your seller console.

steps.title: Get paid
steps.text: Ship orders and receive weekly payouts.
